<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="es">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>BuggyIA · 93 Juegos · 2 Niveles</title>
<link rel="manifest" href="data:application/json;base64,">

<script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
<style>
  :root{--bg:#0b1026;--card:#141a38;--text:#f1f5ff;--muted:#8b93c2;--accent:#22d3ee;--accent2:#fb923c;--gold:#facc15;--green:#4ade80;--pink:#f472b6;--purple:#a78bfa;--border:rgba(139,147,194,.22);}
  *{box-sizing:border-box}
  body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);font-family:'Fredoka',sans-serif;color:var(--text);min-height:100vh;overflow-x:hidden;background:radial-gradient(1000px 500px at 80% -10%,rgba(34,211,238,.12),transparent 60%),radial-gradient(800px 500px at 10% 110%,rgba(251,146,60,.10),transparent 60%),linear-gradient(160deg,#0b1026 0%,#131a3d 50%,#0b1026 100%);}
  .starfield{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;pointer-events:none;border-radius:inherit}
  .star{position:absolute;background:#fff;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 6px 1px rgba(255,255,255,.85);animation:twinkle 2.6s ease-in-out infinite}
  .lucero{position:absolute;width:5px;height:5px;background:#fff;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 10px 3px #fff,0 0 22px 7px rgba(255,255,255,.55);animation:twinkle 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;z-index:1;}
  #astroMoon{position:absolute;top:14px;right:22px;width:54px;height:54px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 32%,#fefce8,#e2e8f0 65%,#cbd5e1);box-shadow:0 0 34px 8px rgba(254,240,138,.55),inset -7px -7px 14px rgba(100,116,139,.55);z-index:1;animation:moonFloat 6s ease-in-out infinite;}
  #astroMoon::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:13px;left:11px;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(148,163,184,.5);box-shadow:17px 15px 0 -2px rgba(148,163,184,.4),7px 24px 0 -3px rgba(148,163,184,.35);}
  @keyframes moonFloat{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-8px)}}
  @keyframes twinkle{0%,100%{opacity:.2;transform:scale(.8)}50%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1.2)}}
  @keyframes floaty{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-10px)}}
  #astroWrap{animation:floaty 4s ease-in-out infinite;transform-origin:center bottom}
  @keyframes celebrateJump{0%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(0) scale(1)}35%{transform:translateY(-36px) rotate(180deg) scale(1.12)}70%{transform:translateY(-12px) rotate(320deg) scale(1.06)}100%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(360deg) scale(1)}}
  #astroWrap.celebrate{animation:celebrateJump .7s ease-in-out 3}
#astroWrap.celebrate-flip{animation:astroFlip .8s ease-in-out 2}
#gameArea{perspective:900px;}
#buggy-avatar{animation:astroFloat 3.2s ease-in-out infinite;}
@keyframes astroFloat{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) translateX(0)}25%{transform:translateY(-10px) translateX(7px)}50%{transform:translateY(-3px) translateX(-7px)}75%{transform:translateY(-13px) translateX(4px)}}
@keyframes astroFlip{0%{transform:translateY(0) rotateX(0) scale(1)}35%{transform:translateY(-42px) rotateX(-180deg) scale(1.12)}70%{transform:translateY(-16px) rotateX(-300deg) scale(1.05)}100%{transform:translateY(0) rotateX(-360deg) scale(1)}}
#astroWrap{width:clamp(150px,46vw,240px)!important;margin:clamp(2px,1.5vh,16px) auto 0 auto!important;}#gameScreen>div:first-child{margin-bottom:6px!important;gap:4px!important}#gameScreen>div:nth-child(2){margin-bottom:8px!important;padding-top:4px!important;padding-bottom:4px!important}
@media(max-height:660px){#astroWrap{width:clamp(135px,40vw,200px)!important;margin:clamp(4px,2vh,20px) auto 0 auto!important;}#wordTile{width:76px!important;height:76px!important;font-size:34px!important;}.bubble{padding:6px 10px!important;margin-bottom:6px!important;}}
  @keyframes blink{0%,92%,100%{transform:scaleY(1)}95%{transform:scaleY(.08)}}
  .eyes{animation:blink 4.5s infinite;transform-origin:center}
  .mouthOpen{transform:scaleY(0);transform-origin:center;transition:transform .08s}
  .btn{cursor:pointer;transition:transform .12s ease,box-shadow .2s ease,filter .2s;user-select:none;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;border:none;font-family:'Fredoka',sans-serif;}
  .btn:active{transform:scale(.94)}
  .btn:hover{filter:brightness(1.1)}
  .pulse-ring{animation:pulseRing 1.6s ease-out infinite}
  @keyframes pulseRing{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(34,211,238,.5)}70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 16px rgba(34,211,238,0)}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(34,211,238,0)}}
  .listening{animation:pulseRing 1.2s ease-out infinite}
  .word-letter{display:inline-block;animation:letterPop .5s ease backwards}
  @keyframes letterPop{0%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px) scale(.6)}100%{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0) scale(1)}}
  @keyframes shake{0%,100%{transform:translateX(0)}20%,60%{transform:translateX(-7px)}40%,80%{transform:translateX(7px)}}
  .shake{animation:shake .45s ease}
  .progress-fill{transition:width .6s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
  .glass{background:rgba(20,26,56,.72);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);border:1px solid var(--border)}
  .fade-in{animation:fadeIn .4s ease forwards}
  @keyframes fadeIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
  .bubble{position:relative}
  .bubble::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:30px;bottom:-10px;width:0;height:0;border-left:12px solid transparent;border-right:5px solid transparent;border-top:12px solid var(--card)}
  .mic-wave{display:inline-block;width:4px;height:14px;margin:0 2px;background:var(--accent);border-radius:2px;animation:micWave 1s ease-in-out infinite;vertical-align:middle}
  .mic-wave:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.15s}.mic-wave:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.3s}.mic-wave:nth-child(4){animation-delay:.45s}
  @keyframes micWave{0%,100%{transform:scaleY(.4)}50%{transform:scaleY(1.3)}}
  .reward-badge{animation:badgePop .5s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1) backwards}
  @keyframes badgePop{0%{opacity:0;transform:scale(0) rotate(-20deg)}100%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1) rotate(0)}}
  .cat-card{transition:transform .2s ease,box-shadow .2s ease}
  .cat-card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px)}
  .option-card{transition:transform .15s ease,border-color .2s,background .2s}
  .option-card:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}
  .option-card.correct{border-color:var(--green)!important;background:rgba(74,222,128,.18)!important;animation:badgePop .4s ease}
  .option-card.wrong{border-color:#f87171!important;background:rgba(248,113,113,.15)!important;animation:shake .45s ease}
  .trophy{transition:all .3s}
  .trophy.unlocked{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(250,204,21,.7))}
  .hidden-screen{display:none!important}
  .big-3d{text-shadow:0 4px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.3),0 8px 24px rgba(34,211,238,.4)}
  .mem-card{position:relative;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .4s;transform-style:preserve-3d;aspect-ratio:1/1;}
  .mem-card.flipped{transform:rotateY(180deg)}
  .mem-face{position:absolute;inset:0;backface-visibility:hidden;-webkit-backface-visibility:hidden;border-radius:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:700;}
  .mem-back{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--accent),#0ea5e9);color:#0b1026;font-size:22px;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(34,211,238,.3);}
  .mem-front{background:var(--card);border:2px solid var(--border);transform:rotateY(180deg);font-size:18px;}
  .mem-card.matched{opacity:.5;pointer-events:none;}
  .tile{border-radius:16px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:700;color:#fff;text-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.3);box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.3);}
  .section-label{font-size:19px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;margin:22px 4px 12px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;}
  .section-label::after{content:'';flex:1;height:1px;background:var(--border);}
  .dot{width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent);display:inline-block;margin:2px;}
  .spell-tile{cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s;}
  .spell-tile:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)}
  .spell-tile.used{opacity:.25;pointer-events:none;}
  .timer-bar{height:8px;background:rgba(139,147,194,.2);border-radius:99px;overflow:hidden;margin-top:8px;}
  .timer-fill{height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--green),var(--gold),#f87171);border-radius:99px;transition:width .2s linear;}
  .stat-bar{height:10px;background:rgba(139,147,194,.2);border-radius:99px;overflow:hidden;flex:1;}
  .stat-fill{height:100%;border-radius:99px;transition:width .5s ease;}
  .pet-btn{transition:transform .15s;cursor:pointer;}
  .pet-btn:active{transform:scale(.92);}
  @keyframes petBounce{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-10px)}}
  .pet-bounce{animation:petBounce 2s ease-in-out infinite;}
  @keyframes eatAnim{0%,100%{transform:scale(1)}50%{transform:scale(1.12)}}
  .pet-eat{animation:eatAnim .4s ease-in-out 3;}
  @keyframes sleepZ{0%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(0) scale(.6)}50%{opacity:1}100%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-30px) scale(1.2)}}
  .sleep-z{animation:sleepZ 2s ease-in-out infinite;position:absolute;font-weight:700;color:var(--accent);}
  @keyframes ballMove{0%{left:5%}50%{left:75%}100%{left:5%}}
  .ball-move{animation:ballMove 1.6s ease-in-out infinite;position:absolute;top:40%;}
  .modal-bg{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(11,16,38,.92);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);z-index:100;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px;}

  /* ===== v5: MAS COLOR ===== */
  #mcqQuestion{background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(34,211,238,.14),rgba(244,114,182,.14),rgba(250,204,21,.14));border-radius:16px;padding:12px 16px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--border);}
  .section-label{text-shadow:0 0 14px currentColor;letter-spacing:.18em;}
  .cat-card{transition:transform .2s ease,box-shadow .2s ease;}
  .cat-card:hover{transform:translateY(-5px) scale(1.02);box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(34,211,238,.35);}
  .progress-fill{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#f472b6,#a78bfa,#22d3ee,#4ade80,#facc15,#fb923c)!important;background-size:300% 100%;animation:rainbowMove 4s linear infinite;}
  @keyframes rainbowMove{0%{background-position:0% 0}100%{background-position:300% 0}}
  .tile{background-size:200% 200%!important;animation:tileShine 3s ease infinite;}
  @keyframes tileShine{0%,100%{background-position:0% 0}50%{background-position:100% 100%}}
  #levelTitle{text-shadow:0 0 18px currentColor;}
  .glass{box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.35), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.06);}

  /* ===== v10: experiencia premium mobile ===== */
  .cat-card{box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.45), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.08);}
  .cat-card:hover{transform:translateY(-5px) scale(1.03);}
  .option-card{font-size:22px!important;letter-spacing:.5px;}
  #levelTitle{font-size:22px!important;}
  .glass{border-radius:20px;}
  .btn{font-family:'Fredoka',sans-serif;}
  @keyframes floaty{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-8px)}}

  /* ===== v12: experiencia premium ===== */
  #astroWrap{position:relative;animation:astroFloat 5s ease-in-out infinite;}
  @keyframes astroFloat{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) translateX(0);}25%{transform:translateY(-12px) translateX(6px);}50%{transform:translateY(-4px) translateX(-6px);}75%{transform:translateY(-14px) translateX(3px);}}
  #astroWrap::after{content:"";position:absolute;bottom:-14px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:34px;height:46px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fef08a 0%,#fb923c 40%,#ef4444 75%,transparent 100%);border-radius:50% 50% 50% 50%/70% 70% 30% 30%;filter:blur(1px);animation:flameFlicker .12s infinite alternate;z-index:0;}
  #astroWrap::before{content:"";position:absolute;bottom:-6px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:20px;height:26px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff,#fef08a);border-radius:50%;opacity:.9;animation:flameFlicker .1s infinite alternate-reverse;z-index:1;}
  @keyframes flameFlicker{from{transform:translateX(-50%) scaleY(1) scaleX(1);}to{transform:translateX(-50%) scaleY(1.25) scaleX(.85);}}
  .shooting-star{position:absolute;width:3px;height:3px;background:#fff;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 6px 2px #fff;opacity:0;z-index:0;}
  .shooting-star::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:80px;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#fff,transparent);transform:rotate(-35deg);transform-origin:left;}
  .ss1{top:12%;left:80%;animation:shoot 4.5s linear infinite;}
  .ss2{top:30%;left:90%;animation:shoot 6s linear 1.5s infinite;}
  .ss3{top:55%;left:75%;animation:shoot 5.2s linear 3s infinite;}
  @keyframes shoot{0%{opacity:0;transform:translate(0,0) rotate(-35deg);}5%{opacity:1;}40%{opacity:1;}60%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-320px,220px) rotate(-35deg);}100%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-320px,220px) rotate(-35deg);}}
  .btn{font-family:'Fredoka',sans-serif;}
  #teachBtn,#listenBtn,#micBtn,#repeatBtn,#prevBtn,#nextBtn{min-height:54px;font-size:16px!important;padding:10px 18px!important;}
  #completeScreen button, .win-btn{min-height:56px;font-size:18px!important;}
  .pet-emoji{position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-52%);font-size:74px;line-height:1;pointer-events:none;z-index:5;filter:drop-shadow(0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.4));}
  #gameScreen{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 20% 10%, rgba(167,139,250,.18), transparent 50%), radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 80%, rgba(34,211,238,.15), transparent 50%), #070b18;}
</style>

<style>
/* ===== OVERRIDE PREMIUM GLAMOUR ===== */
.premium-bg{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden;}
.premium-bg .orb{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;filter:blur(70px);opacity:.55;animation:orbFloat 14s ease-in-out infinite;}
.orb1{width:360px;height:360px;background:radial-gradient(circle,#22d3ee,transparent 70%);top:-100px;left:-100px;}
.orb2{width:320px;height:320px;background:radial-gradient(circle,#f472b6,transparent 70%);top:32%;right:-120px;animation-delay:-5s;}
.orb3{width:300px;height:300px;background:radial-gradient(circle,#facc15,transparent 70%);bottom:-80px;left:18%;animation-delay:-9s;}
@keyframes orbFloat{0%,100%{transform:translate(0,0) scale(1);}50%{transform:translate(36px,-44px) scale(1.18);}}
.max-w-5xl{position:relative;z-index:2;}

/* Titulo nítido premium (sin sombra borrosa) */
#homeScreen h1.big-3d{text-shadow:none!important;filter:drop-shadow(0 5px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.4)) drop-shadow(0 0 22px rgba(251,146,60,.7));font-size:60px!important;letter-spacing:1px;-webkit-text-stroke:1.5px rgba(0,0,0,.22);}
#homeScreen .text-center p[style*="letter-spacing"]{text-shadow:0 0 16px rgba(34,211,238,.85),0 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.4);}

/* Botones redondos premium (solo los de accion, no las tarjetas de juego) */
#openPetBtn,#voiceBtn,#btn-instalar,#teachBtn,#listenBtn,#micBtn,#prevBtn,#nextBtn,#homeBtn,#levelBtn,#replayBtn,#typeCheck,#manualDoneBtn,#overlayHomeBtn,#petHomeBtn,#petConfirmBtn,#giftCloseBtn,#sdCheck,#trenGo,#platJump,#jumpBtn,#bathStepBtn,.pet-btn,.win-btn,#completeScreen button,#howBtn{border-radius:999px!important;box-shadow:0 7px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.4),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.28)!important;transition:transform .12s ease,box-shadow .2s ease;}
#howBtn{box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(167,139,250,.25),0 7px 20px rgba(167,139,250,.55)!important;}
/* #btn-instalar arranca oculto */

/* Tarjetas de juegos premium con brillo */
.cat-card{border-radius:26px!important;box-shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.5),0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.08),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.1)!important;position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
.cat-card::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:-70%;left:-70%;width:70%;height:240%;background:linear-gradient(115deg,transparent 42%,rgba(255,255,255,.16) 50%,transparent 58%);transform:rotate(12deg);animation:cardShine 5s ease-in-out infinite;pointer-events:none;}
@keyframes cardShine{0%,55%{left:-70%;}100%{left:140%;}}
.cat-card .tile{border-radius:22px!important;}
.cat-card h3{text-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.5);}

/* Banner gratis premium */
#homeScreen > div.fade-in.rounded-2xl{border-radius:24px!important;box-shadow:0 0 34px rgba(250,204,21,.5),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.15)!important;}

/* Etiquetas de seccion */
.section-label{font-size:22px!important;text-shadow:0 0 20px currentColor,0 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.45)!important;}

/* Panel de mascota */
#petStage{filter:drop-shadow(0 10px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.45));}

/* Toast de instalacion */
#toastMsg{position:fixed;bottom:26px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:linear-gradient(135deg,#a78bfa,#7c3aed);color:#fff;padding:13px 24px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.45);z-index:600;display:none;max-width:92%;text-align:center;line-height:1.35;}
</style>

<style>
#homeScreen *[style*="background-clip:text"], #homeScreen *[style*="-webkit-background-clip"]{
  background:none!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#ffffff!important;color:#ffffff!important;
  text-shadow:0 3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.45),0 0 18px rgba(251,146,60,.65)!important;
  animation:none!important;filter:none!important;-webkit-text-stroke:0!important;
}
#homeScreen h1.big-3d{font-size:62px!important;}
@keyframes heartUp{0%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(0) scale(.5);}15%{opacity:1;}100%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-80px) scale(1.4);}}
#petStage{cursor:pointer;}
/* #btn-instalar arranca oculto */
/* ===== MASCOTA PREMIUM v2 ===== */
.pet-bubble{position:absolute;top:-6px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(-100%);background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ffffff,#fef3c7);color:#1e293b;padding:11px 17px;border-radius:20px;font-size:16px;font-weight:800;max-width:260px;box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.4);z-index:30;display:none;line-height:1.35;text-align:center;font-family:'Fredoka',sans-serif;}
.pet-bubble.show{display:block;animation:bubblePop .35s ease;}
.pet-bubble:after{content:"";position:absolute;bottom:-9px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);border-left:10px solid transparent;border-right:10px solid transparent;border-top:10px solid #fef3c7;}
@keyframes bubblePop{0%{opacity:0;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(-92%) scale(.7);}100%{opacity:1;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(-100%) scale(1);}}
.dirty-fly{position:absolute;font-size:20px;animation:flyWiggle 1.1s ease-in-out infinite;pointer-events:none;z-index:9;}
@keyframes flyWiggle{0%,100%{transform:translate(0,0) rotate(0);}25%{transform:translate(7px,-9px) rotate(22deg);}50%{transform:translate(-5px,-15px) rotate(-16deg);}75%{transform:translate(-9px,-5px) rotate(11deg);}}
.pet-alert{margin:8px auto 12px;max-width:360px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(248,113,113,.22),rgba(251,146,60,.22));border:2px solid #f87171;border-radius:18px;padding:12px 16px;font-size:15px;font-weight:800;color:#fecaca;text-align:center;animation:alertPulse 1.4s ease-in-out infinite;line-height:1.4;}
@keyframes alertPulse{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(248,113,113,.55);}50%{box-shadow:0 0 0 10px rgba(248,113,113,0);}}
.pet-alert button{margin-top:9px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#facc15,#f59e0b);color:#7c2d12;border:none;border-radius:999px;padding:10px 22px;font-weight:900;font-size:15px;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 7px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.4);font-family:'Fredoka',sans-serif;}
.planet-wrap{position:relative;height:250px;max-width:360px;margin:0 auto;border-radius:20px;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%,rgba(30,41,59,.95),#020617);overflow:hidden;border:2px solid rgba(167,139,250,.45);box-shadow:inset 0 0 40px rgba(99,102,241,.3);}
.planet-sun{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);width:50px;height:50px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%,#fef9c3,#f59e0b 70%);box-shadow:0 0 34px #facc15,0 0 70px rgba(250,204,21,.55);z-index:2;}
.planet-dot{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .2s;box-shadow:0 0 14px currentColor;z-index:3;}
.planet-dot:active{transform:scale(1.3);}
.orbit-ring{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;border:1px dashed rgba(148,163,184,.28);border-radius:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);}
.pet-travel{animation:travelZoom .85s ease;}
@keyframes travelZoom{0%{transform:scale(1);}50%{transform:scale(1.45) rotate(18deg);filter:brightness(1.7) saturate(1.4);}100%{transform:scale(1);}}
.stat-bar{height:14px!important;border-radius:999px!important;}

<style>
.shooting-star{position:absolute;width:130px;height:2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.9),transparent);border-radius:2px;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;}
.shooting-star::after{content:'';position:absolute;right:-2px;top:-3px;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 12px 3px rgba(255,255,255,.9);}
.s1{top:10%;left:-20%;animation:shoot 8s linear infinite;}
.s2{top:26%;left:-20%;animation:shoot 12s linear infinite;animation-delay:3.5s;}
.s3{top:44%;left:-20%;animation:shoot 10s linear infinite;animation-delay:7s;}
@keyframes shoot{0%{transform:translateX(0) rotate(18deg);opacity:0;}4%{opacity:1;}35%{opacity:1;}55%{transform:translateX(150vw) rotate(18deg);opacity:0;}100%{opacity:0;}}
@keyframes astroSpin{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(0deg);}18%{transform:translateY(-9px) rotate(-7deg);}36%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(7deg);}54%{transform:translateY(-6px) rotate(0deg) scale(1.06);}70%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(360deg);}84%{transform:translateY(-4px) rotate(360deg);}}

<style>

#adBanner,#espacio-google,#banner-superawesome{background:rgba(20,26,56,.6)!important;border-color:rgba(148,158,205,.25)!important;}
/* ---- Suavizar brillos que encandilan ---- */
#homeScreen > div.fade-in.rounded-2xl{box-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(250,204,21,.22),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.1)!important;}
.big-3d{filter:drop-shadow(0 4px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.4)) drop-shadow(0 0 14px rgba(251,146,60,.40))!important;}

<style>

@keyframes buggyFloat{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-6px)}}

}
/* --- Mascota premium: comida arrastrable --- */
.food-tray{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;justify-content:center;align-items:center;}
.food-item{width:54px;height:54px;border-radius:16px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:30px;cursor:grab;touch-action:none;position:relative;box-shadow:0 6px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.35),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.3);transition:transform .15s;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none;}
.food-item:active{cursor:grabbing;transform:scale(1.1);}
.food-item .food-count{position:absolute;top:-6px;right:-6px;background:#0b1026;color:#facc15;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;border-radius:999px;padding:1px 6px;border:2px solid #facc15;}
.food-drag{position:fixed;z-index:9999;width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:16px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:34px;pointer-events:none;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.15);box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.5);}
#petStage.pet-chew{animation:petChew .35s ease-in-out 6;}
@keyframes petChew{0%,100%{transform:scale(1)}50%{transform:scale(1.07,.93);}}
.mouth-target{position:absolute;left:50%;top:58%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);width:96px;height:74px;border-radius:50%;z-index:11;pointer-events:none;transition:box-shadow .2s;}
.mouth-target.hot{box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(74,222,128,.55);animation:mouthPulse .5s ease-in-out infinite;}
@keyframes mouthPulse{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(74,222,128,.55)}50%{box-shadow:0 0 0 12px rgba(74,222,128,.12)}}
/* --- Mascota premium: bano con esponja y espuma real --- */
.bath-sponge{width:64px;height:52px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#facc15,#f59e0b);border-radius:14px 14px 18px 18px;position:absolute;cursor:grab;touch-action:none;z-index:40;box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.4),inset 0 2px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.4);user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none;}
.bath-sponge::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:-8px;left:6px;right:6px;height:14px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#4ade80,#22c55e);border-radius:10px 10px 4px 4px;}
.bath-sponge.dragging{cursor:grabbing;transform:scale(1.1);}
.foam-bubble{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 32% 28%,#ffffff,rgba(255,255,255,.85) 60%,rgba(186,230,253,.7));box-shadow:inset -2px -3px 6px rgba(125,211,252,.4);pointer-events:none;z-index:12;animation:foamPop 2.4s ease-out forwards;}
@keyframes foamPop{0%{transform:scale(.3);opacity:0}15%{transform:scale(1.1);opacity:1}70%{opacity:.95}100%{transform:scale(1.5) translateY(-14px);opacity:0}}
.dirty-spot{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(120,72,30,.85),rgba(90,53,20,.55));z-index:11;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .5s,transform .5s;}
.dirty-spot.clean{opacity:0;transform:scale(.2);}
.bath-progress{height:10px;background:rgba(139,147,194,.2);border-radius:99px;overflow:hidden;margin:8px auto 0;max-width:260px;}
.bath-progress-fill{height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#22d3ee,#4ade80);border-radius:99px;transition:width .3s ease;width:0%;}
.sparkle{position:absolute;font-size:20px;pointer-events:none;z-index:12;animation:sparkleUp 1.2s ease-out forwards;}
@keyframes sparkleUp{0%{transform:translateY(0) scale(.5);opacity:0}30%{opacity:1}100%{transform:translateY(-40px) scale(1.3) rotate(40deg);opacity:0}}
</style>

<style>
/* ===== Premium polish pack (aditivo, no toca logica ni ads) ===== */
@keyframes premFadeUp{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
@keyframes premShimmer{0%{transform:translateX(-100%)}100%{transform:translateX(220%)}}
@keyframes premGlow{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(34,211,238,.30)}50%{box-shadow:0 6px 28px rgba(34,211,238,.65)}}
#gameArea{animation:premFadeUp .55s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) both}
.bubble{animation:premFadeUp .55s .12s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) both}
#wordCard{animation:premFadeUp .55s .24s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) both}
#teachBtn{animation:premGlow 2.6s ease-in-out infinite}
#teachBtn,#listenBtn,#micBtn,#prevBtn,#nextBtn,#homeBtn{transition:transform .16s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),box-shadow .2s ease,filter .2s ease!important}
#teachBtn:hover,#listenBtn:hover,#micBtn:hover,#prevBtn:hover,#nextBtn:hover,#homeBtn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);filter:brightness(1.12)}
#teachBtn:active,#listenBtn:active,#micBtn:active,#prevBtn:active,#nextBtn:active,#homeBtn:active{transform:translateY(0) scale(.96)}
#progressFill{transition:width .55s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)!important;position:relative;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(34,211,238,.45)}
#progressFill::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.4),transparent);animation:premShimmer 1.8s linear infinite}
.glass{box-shadow:0 12px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.45),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.10),inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.04)!important}
</style>
<style>
/* ===== CIELO ESTRELLADO GLOBAL + BOTONES PREMIUM NEON ===== */
html,body{background:
 radial-gradient(900px 520px at 12% 8%, rgba(139,92,246,.24), transparent 60%),
 radial-gradient(820px 540px at 88% 22%, rgba(34,211,238,.20), transparent 60%),
 radial-gradient(760px 620px at 50% 105%, rgba(244,114,182,.16), transparent 60%),
 radial-gradient(600px 400px at 70% 70%, rgba(250,204,21,.10), transparent 60%),
 linear-gradient(180deg,#04060f 0%,#0a0f2e 45%,#050818 100%)!important;}
#cieloEstrellas{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden;}
#cieloEstrellas::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:-25%;left:-15%;width:75%;height:170%;background:linear-gradient(115deg,transparent 40%,rgba(167,139,250,.10) 47%,rgba(255,255,255,.13) 50%,rgba(34,211,238,.10) 53%,transparent 60%);filter:blur(20px);transform:rotate(8deg);}
.cee-star{position:absolute;background:#fff;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 6px 1px rgba(255,255,255,.9);animation:ceeTwinkle 3s ease-in-out infinite;}
.cee-big{box-shadow:0 0 10px 3px currentColor,0 0 22px 7px rgba(255,255,255,.45)!important;}
@keyframes ceeTwinkle{0%,100%{opacity:.12;transform:scale(.65)}50%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1.2)}}
/* Pantallas semitransparentes para que se vean las estrellas a través */
#homeScreen,#gameScreen,#petScreen{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 0%,rgba(30,41,59,.28),rgba(2,6,23,.70))!important;}
/* Se rehabilitan las capas de estrellas y luna que el bloque negro había ocultado */
.premium-bg,.starfield,.shooting-star,#astroMoon{display:block!important;}
.starfield{display:block!important;}

/* ===== BOTONES PILDORA CON GLOW (fila superior) ===== */
#teachBtn,#listenBtn,#micBtn{
 flex:1 1 100px!important;max-width:175px;min-height:56px!important;padding:12px 18px!important;
 border-radius:999px!important;font-weight:800!important;font-size:16px!important;color:#fff!important;
 display:flex!important;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;border:none!important;cursor:pointer;
 font-family:'Fredoka',sans-serif!important;letter-spacing:.2px;
 transition:transform .15s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),box-shadow .2s ease,filter .2s ease!important;}
#teachBtn{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#e9d5ff,#c084fc 45%,#8b5cf6 75%,#7c3aed)!important;
 box-shadow:0 0 26px rgba(168,85,247,.85),0 10px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.5),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.5)!important;}
#listenBtn{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#a5f3fc,#22d3ee 45%,#06b6d4 75%,#0891b2)!important;color:#063644!important;
 box-shadow:0 0 26px rgba(34,211,238,.85),0 10px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.5),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.55)!important;}
#micBtn{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#bfdbfe,#60a5fa 45%,#3b82f6 75%,#2563eb)!important;
 box-shadow:0 0 26px rgba(59,130,246,.85),0 10px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.5),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.5)!important;}
#teachBtn:hover,#listenBtn:hover,#micBtn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px) scale(1.04)!important;filter:brightness(1.12)!important;}
#teachBtn:active,#listenBtn:active,#micBtn:active{transform:scale(.93)!important;filter:brightness(.95)!important;}
#micBtn svg,#teachBtn svg,#listenBtn svg{flex:0 0 auto;}
#micBtn.listening{box-shadow:0 0 36px rgba(96,165,250,1),0 0 70px rgba(59,130,246,.75)!important;animation:micGlowPulse 1s ease-in-out infinite!important;}
@keyframes micGlowPulse{0%,100%{transform:scale(1)}50%{transform:scale(1.07)}}

/* ===== BOTONES CIRCULARES PREV/NEXT (fila inferior) ===== */
#prevBtn,#nextBtn{
 width:70px!important;height:70px!important;min-height:0!important;padding:0!important;
 border-radius:50%!important;border:none!important;cursor:pointer;
 display:flex!important;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
 font-family:'Fredoka',sans-serif!important;line-height:1;
 transition:transform .15s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),box-shadow .2s ease,filter .2s ease!important;}
#prevBtn{background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 28%,#e9d5ff,#a855f7 55%,#6d28d9)!important;
 box-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(139,92,246,.9),0 10px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.55),inset 0 2px 6px rgba(255,255,255,.55)!important;}
#nextBtn{background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 28%,#bae6fd,#3b82f6 55%,#1e40af)!important;
 box-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(59,130,246,.95),0 10px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.55),inset 0 2px 6px rgba(255,255,255,.55)!important;}
#prevBtn:hover,#nextBtn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px) scale(1.08)!important;filter:brightness(1.12)!important;}
#prevBtn:active,#nextBtn:active{transform:scale(.88)!important;}
#prevBtn svg,#nextBtn svg{width:26px;height:26px;fill:#fff;filter:drop-shadow(0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.45));flex:0 0 auto;}

/* Layout de las dos filas */
#premiumControls{margin-top:10px;}
#premiumControls .ctrl-row-pills{display:flex;gap:10px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:14px;}
#premiumControls .ctrl-row-circles{display:flex;gap:32px;justify-content:center;align-items:center;}
@media(max-width:380px){
 #teachBtn,#listenBtn,#micBtn{font-size:13px!important;padding:10px 12px!important;min-height:48px!important;gap:5px!important;}
 #prevBtn,#nextBtn{width:58px!important;height:58px!important;}
 #premiumControls .ctrl-row-circles{gap:22px;}
 #prevBtn svg,#nextBtn svg{width:22px;height:22px;}
}
</style>
<style>
/* ===== FONDO NEGRO + SOLO LA LUNA (sin estrellas ni nebulosas) ===== */
html,body{background:#000!important;}
div:not(.stat-fill):not(#astroMoon){background-color:#000!important;}
#wordCard,#flashPanel,.glass,.bubble{background-image:none!important;background:#000!important;}
#petArea,#petStage{background:#000!important;}
#homeScreen,#gameScreen,#petScreen{background:#000!important;}
/* Ocultar todo lo de estrellas/orbes/estrellas fugaces */
#cieloEstrellas{display:none!important;}
.premium-bg,.orb,.starfield,.shooting-star{display:none!important;}
/* Conservar SOLO la luna */
#astroMoon{display:block!important;background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 32%,#fefce8,#e2e8f0 65%,#cbd5e1)!important;box-shadow:0 0 34px 8px rgba(254,240,138,.55),inset -7px -7px 14px rgba(100,116,139,.55)!important;}
#astroMoon::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:13px;left:11px;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(148,163,184,.5);box-shadow:17px 15px 0 -2px rgba(148,163,184,.4),7px 24px 0 -3px rgba(148,163,184,.35);}
</style>
<style>
/* ===== Ajuste 9:16: sube los botones inferiores para que entren completos en pantalla de celular ===== */
@media (max-width:540px) and (orientation:portrait){
  #astroWrap{width:clamp(118px,36vw,165px)!important;margin:0 auto!important;}
  #gameArea > div.relative.flex{gap:6px!important;}
  .bubble{padding:7px 10px!important;margin-bottom:8px!important;}
  #wordCard{padding:10px!important;}
  #wordTile{margin-top:4px!important;width:84px!important;height:84px!important;font-size:38px!important;}
  #feedback{min-height:18px!important;margin-top:3px!important;}
  #premiumControls{margin-top:6px!important;}
  #premiumControls .ctrl-row-pills{margin-bottom:8px!important;gap:8px!important;}
  #teachBtn,#listenBtn,#micBtn{min-height:46px!important;padding:9px 10px!important;font-size:13px!important;gap:6px!important;}
  #premiumControls .ctrl-row-circles{gap:24px!important;}
  #prevBtn,#nextBtn{width:60px!important;height:60px!important;}
  #prevBtn svg,#nextBtn svg{width:24px!important;height:24px!important;}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="cieloEstrellas"></div>
<div class="premium-bg"><div class="orb orb1"></div><div class="orb orb2"></div><div class="orb orb3"></div><div class="shooting-star s1"></div><div class="shooting-star s2"></div><div class="shooting-star s3"></div></div>

<div class="max-w-5xl mx-auto px-3 py-4 sm:px-5">

  <!-- ================= HOME ================= -->

          <h1 class="big-3d" style="font-size:54px;font-weight:700;margin:0;line-height:1;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--accent2),var(--pink),var(--accent),var(--gold));background-size:300% auto;-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;animation:rainbowMove 5s linear infinite;">BuggyIA</h1>
          <p style="color:var(--accent);margin:3px 0 0;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;text-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(34,211,238,.6);">Aprendé Inglés Jugando</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <p style="color:var(--muted);margin:8px 0 0;font-size:15px;font-weight:500;">103 juegos · 2 niveles de dificultad · Buggy te explica en castellano y vos hablás en inglés</p>
    </div>
    <!-- ===== CARTEL: PLAN GRATIS PARA SIEMPRE ===== -->
    <div class="fade-in rounded-2xl px-4 py-3 mb-3 text-center" style="background:linear-gradient(100deg,rgba(74,222,128,.20),rgba(250,204,21,.20),rgba(244,114,182,.20));border:2px solid var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 28px rgba(250,204,21,.4), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.12);">
      <div style="font-size:27px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.04em;line-height:1.15;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#4ade80,#facc15,#fb923c);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 14px rgba(250,204,21,.45));">★ Plan GRATIS para siempre ★</div>
      <div style="font-size:13px;color:var(--text);font-weight:600;margin-top:5px;">Sin límites · Sin tarjeta de crédito · Todos los juegos desbloqueados</div>
    </div>
    <!-- ===== MICROFONO QUE EXPLICA TODA LA FUNCION ===== -->
    <div class="glass rounded-2xl px-4 py-3 mb-3 fade-in" style="display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;box-shadow:0 8px 26px rgba(167,139,250,.25);">
      <button id="howBtn" class="btn pulse-ring" style="flex:0 0 auto;width:60px;height:60px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--purple),#7c3aed);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(167,139,250,.55);" title="Escuchá cómo funciona">
        <svg width="27" height="27" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="9" y="2" width="6" height="12" rx="3"/><path d="M5 10a7 7 0 0 0 14 0M12 19v3"/></svg>
      </button>
      <div style="flex:1;min-width:200px;">
        <div style="font-size:15px;font-weight:700;color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:3px;">¿Cómo funciona? Tocá el micrófono</div>
        <div id="howText" style="font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.55;">1. Buggy explica en español · 2. Escuchá la palabra en inglés · 3. Repetí con el micrófono · ¡Tenés una mascota que criás, ganás premios y crece con vos! · Inglés inicial gratis para mejores notas</div>
      </div>

        <span style="font-weight:700;font-size:20px;" id="totalStars">0</span><span style="color:var(--muted);font-size:14px;font-weight:600;">estrellas</span>
        <span style="color:var(--muted);font-size:14px;margin-left:10px;font-weight:600;">Nivel <strong id="xpLevel" style="color:var(--accent);font-size:16px;">1</strong></span>

        </button>
        <button id="voiceBtn" class="btn rounded-xl px-2.5 py-1.5" style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,#a78bfa,#7c3aed);color:#fff;font-weight:700;font-size:12px;" title="Cambiar voz">♪ Voz</button>
        <div class="trophy"><svg width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="rgba(139,147,194,.3)" stroke="rgba(139,147,194,.3)" stroke-width="1.5"><path d="M8 21h8M12 17v4M7 4h10v5a5 5 0 0 1-10 0V4z"/></svg></div>
        <div class="trophy"><svg width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="rgba(139,147,194,.3)" stroke="rgba(139,147,194,.3)" stroke-width="1.5"><path d="M8 21h8M12 17v4M7 4h10v5a5 5 0 0 1-10 0V4z"/></svg></div>
        <div class="trophy"><svg width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="rgba(139,147,194,.3)" stroke="rgba(139,147,194,.3)" stroke-width="1.5"><path d="M8 21h8M12 17v4M7 4h10v5a5 5 0 0 1-10 0V4z"/></svg></div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div id="homePetWidget" class="glass rounded-2xl px-4 py-3 mb-3 fade-in" style="background:linear-gradient(100deg,rgba(34,211,238,.14),rgba(167,139,250,.14),rgba(244,114,182,.14));border:2px solid rgba(167,139,250,.45);box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(99,102,241,.3);">
  <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;">
    <div style="flex:1;min-width:190px;">
      <div style="font-size:17px;font-weight:800;color:var(--accent2);margin-bottom:5px;" id="hwPetName">Mi Mascota</div>
      <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:3px;">
        <span style="color:#fb923c;width:52px;">Hambre</span><div class="stat-bar" style="flex:1;height:10px;"><div id="hwFood" class="stat-fill" style="width:60%;background:#fb923c;"></div></div>
      </div>
      <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
        <span style="color:#22d3ee;width:52px;">Limpieza</span><div class="stat-bar" style="flex:1;height:10px;"><div id="hwHygiene" class="stat-fill" style="width:60%;background:#22d3ee;"></div></div>
      </div>
      <div id="hwMsg" style="font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:5px;font-weight:600;"></div>
    </div>
    <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;">
      <button id="hwCareBtn" class="btn rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5" style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fb923c,#ea580c);color:#fff;font-weight:800;font-size:14px;box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.35);">Cuidar Mascota</button>
      <button id="hwPlanetsBtn" class="btn rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5" style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,#818cf8,#c084fc);color:#fff;font-weight:800;font-size:14px;box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.35);">Sistema Solar</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
<div id="engagePanel" class="glass rounded-2xl px-4 py-3 mb-3 fade-in" style="background:linear-gradient(100deg,rgba(250,204,21,.12),rgba(244,114,182,.12),rgba(34,211,238,.12));border:2px solid rgba(250,204,21,.4);box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(250,204,21,.2);">
  <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-bottom:8px;">

    <div style="display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;">
      <span style="font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:var(--accent);">Racha: <strong id="streakDays">0</strong> días</span>
      <button id="achBtn" class="btn rounded-xl px-3 py-1.5" style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,#a78bfa,#7c3aed);color:#fff;font-weight:800;font-size:13px;box-shadow:0 5px 14px rgba(167,139,250,.4);">★ Logros</button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div id="missionList" style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;"></div>
</div>

    <p style="text-align:center;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 12px;">Coleccionalas todas! Cada una te da monedas de regalo.</p>
    <div id="achGrid" style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:8px;"></div>
    <button id="achCloseBtn" class="btn rounded-2xl px-6 py-3 w-full mt-3" style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--accent),#0ea5e9);color:#0b1026;font-weight:800;font-size:15px;">Cerrar</button>

<div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 mb-2">

    <h3 style="margin:0 0 3px;font-size:16px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.25;">Acertijos y Enigmas</h3>

  </div>
  <div class="cat-card glass rounded-2xl p-4 fade-in text-center" id="cardArcade" style="cursor:pointer;border-top:5px solid #22d3ee;min-height:150px;">
    <div class="tile mx-auto" style="width:56px;height:56px;font-size:28px;margin-bottom:8px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#22d3ee,#0ea5e9);box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(34,211,238,.55);">&#127918;</div>
    <h3 style="margin:0 0 3px;font-size:16px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.25;">Mini Arcade</h3>

    <p style="margin:0;font-size:11px;color:#67e8f9;font-weight:600;">&iexcl;Despert&aacute; al campe&oacute;n!</p>
  </div>
</div>
    <p style="text-align:center;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:14px;">Toca un juego para empezar · 100% gratuito</p>

</div>

  </div>

<div id="riddleScreen" class="hidden-screen">

      <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M19 12H5M11 18l-6-6 6-6"/></svg>Men&uacute;
    </button>
    <div style="font-size:20px;font-weight:800;color:#f472b6;text-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(244,114,182,.6);">&#128272; Acertijos y Enigmas</div>
    <div style="width:64px;"></div>
  </div>
  <div id="rddDiffBtns" style="display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;">
    <button class="btn rdd-diff" data-d="facil" style="border:none;border-radius:999px;padding:10px 22px;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#4ade80,#22c55e);color:#0b1026;box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(74,222,128,.45);">F&aacute;cil</button>
    <button class="btn rdd-diff" data-d="medio" style="border:none;border-radius:999px;padding:10px 22px;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#facc15,#f59e0b);color:#0b1026;box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(250,204,21,.45);">Medio</button>
    <button class="btn rdd-diff" data-d="dificil" style="border:none;border-radius:999px;padding:10px 22px;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f87171,#dc2626);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(248,113,113,.45);">Dif&iacute;cil</button>
  </div>
  <div class="glass rounded-3xl p-5 text-center" style="max-width:560px;margin:0 auto;box-shadow:0 14px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.45);">
    <div id="rddCounter" style="font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700;margin-bottom:10px;letter-spacing:.08em;">Acertijo 1 / 18</div>
    <div id="rddQuestion" style="font-size:25px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.6;min-height:110px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:var(--text);">Cargando...</div>
    <div style="display:flex;gap:10px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:14px;"><button id="rddReveal" class="btn" style="border:none;border-radius:999px;padding:12px 28px;font-weight:800;font-size:15px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#a78bfa,#7c3aed);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgba(167,139,250,.5);">&#128065; Ver respuesta</button><button id="rddListen" class="btn" style="border:none;border-radius:999px;padding:12px 24px;font-weight:800;font-size:15px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#22d3ee,#0ea5e9);color:#0b1026;box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgba(34,211,238,.5);cursor:pointer;">🔊 Escuchar</button></div>
    <div id="rddAnswer" style="display:none;margin-top:16px;padding:14px 16px;border-radius:16px;background:rgba(74,222,128,.15);border:2px solid #4ade80;font-size:18px;font-weight:700;color:#4ade80;line-height:1.4;"></div>
    <div style="display:flex;gap:10px;justify-content:center;margin-top:18px;flex-wrap:wrap;">
      <button id="rddPrev" class="btn" style="border:none;border-radius:999px;padding:10px 20px;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;background:rgba(139,147,194,.25);color:var(--text);">&#8592; Anterior</button>
      <button id="rddRand" class="btn" style="border:none;border-radius:999px;padding:10px 20px;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fb923c,#ea580c);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(251,146,60,.4);">&#127922; Aleatorio</button>
      <button id="rddNext" class="btn" style="border:none;border-radius:999px;padding:10px 20px;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;background:rgba(139,147,194,.25);color:var(--text);">Siguiente &#8594;</button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <p style="text-align:center;font-size:12.5px;color:#f9a8d4;margin-top:16px;font-weight:700;">&#128161; Intent&aacute; resolverlo antes de mirar la respuesta</p>
</div>

<!-- ================= MINI ARCADE (pantalla aislada) ================= -->
<div id="arcadeScreen" class="hidden-screen">
  <div class="flex items-center justify-between flex-wrap gap-2 mb-3">
    <button id="arcHomeBtn" class="btn glass rounded-xl px-3 py-1.5 flex items-center gap-1.5" style="color:var(--text);font-weight:600;font-size:13px;">
      <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M19 12H5M11 18l-6-6 6-6"/></svg>Men&uacute;
    </button>
    <div style="font-size:20px;font-weight:800;color:#22d3ee;text-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(34,211,238,.6);">&#127918; Mini Arcade</div>
    <button id="arcBackBtn" class="btn glass rounded-xl px-3 py-1.5 flex items-center gap-1.5" style="color:var(--text);font-weight:600;font-size:13px;display:none;">&#8592; Juegos</button>

</div>
  <!-- ================= GAME SCREEN (layout compacto fullscreen) ================= -->
  <div id="gameScreen" class="hidden-screen">
    <div class="flex items-center justify-between flex-wrap gap-2 mb-3">
      <button id="homeBtn" class="btn glass rounded-xl px-3 py-1.5 flex items-center gap-1.5" style="color:var(--text);font-weight:600;font-size:13px;">
        <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M19 12H5M11 18l-6-6 6-6"/></svg>Menú
      </button>
      <h2 id="levelTitle" style="font-size:17px;font-weight:700;margin:0;"></h2>
      <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
        <div class="glass rounded-xl px-2.5 py-1.5 flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="var(--gold)" stroke="var(--gold)" stroke-width="1"><path d="M12 2l2.9 6.3 6.9.8-5.1 4.7 1.4 6.8L12 17.3 5.9 20.6l1.4-6.8L2.2 9.1l6.9-.8z"/></svg>
          <span id="scoreNum" style="font-weight:700;font-size:14px;">0</span>
        </div>

          <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="var(--pink)" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M13 2L4.5 13.5H11L9.5 22 19 10h-6.5z"/></svg>
          <span id="streakNum" style="font-weight:700;font-size:14px;">0</span>

        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="glass rounded-2xl px-3 py-2 mb-3">
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-1.5">
        <span style="font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:500;" id="progressLabel">Progreso</span>
        <span id="progressText" style="font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--accent);">0 / 0</span>

<script>
// REGISTRO DEL SERVICE WORKER
if('serviceWorker' in navigator){
  window.addEventListener('load',function(){
    navigator.serviceWorker.register('./sw.js')
      .then(function(reg){try{reg.update();}catch(e){}})
      .catch(function(err){ console.log("Error SW:", err); });
  });
}

// LOGICA DEL BOTON DE INSTALACION
// 1. REGISTRO DIRECTO DEL SERVICE WORKER
if ('serviceWorker' in navigator) {
  window.addEventListener('load', function() {
    // Usamos la ruta relativa para asegurar que Vercel/GitHub Pages lo detecte correctamente
    navigator.serviceWorker.register('sw.js')
      .then(function(reg) {
        console.log('SW Registrado con éxito:', reg.scope);
      })
      .catch(function(err) {
        console.log('Error al registrar SW:', err);
      });
  });
}

// 2. LÓGICA DE INSTALACIÓN
var eventoInstalacion = null;
var btnInstalar = document.getElementById('btn-instalar');

// Chrome dispara el evento cuando detecta que el manifest y el SW son válidos
window.addEventListener('beforeinstallprompt', function(e) {
  e.preventDefault();
  eventoInstalacion = e;
  if(btnInstalar) btnInstalar.style.display = 'flex';
});

if(btnInstalar) {
  btnInstalar.addEventListener('click', async function() {
    // Escenario A: Android/Chrome lanzó el evento nativo correctamente
    if (eventoInstalacion) {
      try {
        await eventoInstalacion.prompt();
        const choiceResult = await eventoInstalacion.userChoice;
        if (choiceResult.outcome === 'accepted') {
          console.log('Usuario instaló la app');
          btnInstalar.style.display = 'none';
        }
        eventoInstalacion = null;
      } catch(err) {
        console.log("Error en prompt nativo:", err);
      }
    } 
    // Escenario B: Dispositivos iOS, Firefox o si el evento falló
    else {
      var ua = navigator.userAgent || '';
      var esIOS = /iPhone|iPad|iPod/.test(ua) || (navigator.platform === 'MacIntel' && navigator.maxTouchPoints > 1);
      
      if(esIOS){
        alert("Para instalar la app en tu iPhone/iPad:\n\n1. Tocá el botón 'Compartir' (el cuadradito con la flecha hacia arriba).\n2. Elegí la opción 'Agregar a inicio'.");
      } else {
        alert("Para instalar la app:\n\nTocá el menú de tu navegador (los tres puntitos ⋮) y elegí 'Instalar aplicación' o 'Agregar a pantalla de inicio'.");
      }
    }
  });
}

// Ocultar si ya se instaló
window.addEventListener('appinstalled', function() {
  if(btnInstalar) btnInstalar.style.display = 'none';
  eventoInstalacion = null;
});

// Ocultar si ya se está corriendo la app instalada
if (window.matchMedia('(display-mode: standalone)').matches || window.navigator.standalone === true) {
  if(btnInstalar) btnInstalar.style.display = 'none';
}

// Fallback de 4 segundos: Si no hay prompt nativo, muestra el botón para que funcionen las alertas manuales de iOS
setTimeout(function(){
  if(!eventoInstalacion && btnInstalar && btnInstalar.style.display !== 'flex'){
    var standalone = window.matchMedia('(display-mode: standalone)').matches || window.navigator.standalone === true;
    if(!standalone) btnInstalar.style.display = 'flex';
  }
}, 4000);
</script>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
(function(){
"use strict";
/* ==================== DATOS ==================== */
function numEs(n){var w=["cero","uno","dos","tres","cuatro","cinco","seis","siete","ocho","nueve","diez","once","doce","trece","catorce","quince","dieciséis","diecisiete","dieciocho","diecinueve","veinte","veintiuno","veintidós","veintitrés","veinticuatro","veinticinco","veintiséis","veintisiete","veintiocho","veintinueve","treinta"];return w[n]||String(n);}
function genNums(lo,hi){var a=[];for(var n=lo;n<=hi;n++)a.push({es:numEs(n),en:String(n),tile:String(n)});return a;}
function fc(arr){return arr.map(function(p){return {es:p[0],en:p[1],tile:p[1].charAt(0).toUpperCase()};});}
/* MCQ helper: [preguntaHTML, [opciones], indiceCorrecto, textoParaHablar] */

/* ---- JUEGOS DE INTELIGENCIA (11) ---- */
{id:"imem",name:"Memoria de parejas",section:"Juegos de inteligencia",type:"memory",color:"#a78bfa",icon:"▦",sym:"shapes",intro:"En el juego de memoria tenés que encontrar dos tarjetas iguales. Tocá dos tarjetas: si son iguales quedan boca arriba. Encontrá todos los pares!"},
{id:"iserie",name:"Series numéricas",section:"Juegos de inteligencia",type:"mcq",color:"#22d3ee",icon:"123",intro:"Una serie numérica es una fila de números que siguen una regla, por ejemplo ir sumando de a dos. Tenés que descubrir qué número sigue.",q:[
 ["2, 4, 6, ?",["7","8","9","10"],1,"Dos, cuatro, seis. Qué número sigue?"],
 ["1, 3, 5, ?",["6","7","8","9"],1,"Uno, tres, cinco. Qué sigue?"],
 ["10, 20, 30, ?",["35","40","45","50"],1,"Diez, veinte, treinta. Qué sigue?"],
 ["1, 2, 4, 8, ?",["12","14","16","10"],2,"Uno, dos, cuatro, ocho. Cada vez se duplica. Qué sigue?"],
 ["9, 8, 7, ?",["5","6","4","10"],1,"Nueve, ocho, siete. Va bajando de a uno. Qué sigue?"],
 ["2, 5, 8, ?",["10","11","12","13"],1,"Dos, cinco, ocho. Suman de a tres. Qué sigue?"]
]},
{id:"ipatron",name:"Completar patrones",section:"Juegos de inteligencia",type:"mcq",color:"#f472b6",icon:"▨",intro:"Un patrón es una secuencia que se repite, como círculo, triángulo, círculo, triángulo. Tenés que encontrar qué figura sigue.",q:[
 ["● ▲ ● ▲ ● ?",["●","▲","■","★"],1,"Círculo, triángulo, círculo, triángulo. Qué sigue?"],
 ["■ ■ ▲ ■ ■ ?",["■","▲","●","★"],1,"Dos cuadrados y un triángulo se repiten. Qué sigue?"],
 ["★ ★ ★ ● ★ ★ ?",["★","●","▲","■"],1,"Tres estrellas y un círculo se repiten. Qué sigue?"],
 ["● ● ▲ ▲ ● ?",["▲","●","■","★"],0,"Dos círculos y dos triángulos se repiten. Qué sigue?"],
 ["1 2 1 2 1 ?",["1","2","3","4"],1,"Uno, dos, uno, dos. Qué sigue?"],
 ["▲ ● ■ ▲ ● ?",["▲","●","■","★"],2,"Triángulo, círculo, cuadrado se repiten. Qué sigue?"]
]},
{id:"ilogica",name:"Lógica",section:"Juegos de inteligencia",type:"mcq",color:"#fb923c",icon:"?",intro:"Los juegos de lógica te hacen pensar para encontrar la respuesta correcta. Leé bien la pregunta y pensá un poquito.",q:[

 ["¿Qué tiene cuello pero no cabeza?",["perro","botella","árbol","zapato"],1,"Qué tiene cuello pero no cabeza? Es una botella."],

 ["¿Cuántos meses tienen 28 días?",["1","2","ninguno","todos"],3,"Cuántos meses tienen 28 días? Todos tienen al menos 28."],

]},
{id:"iveloc",name:"Velocidad mental",section:"Juegos de inteligencia",type:"mcq",color:"#f87171",icon:"⚡".replace("⚡","↯"),timed:true,intro:"Este juego es contra reloj: tenés solo 15 segundos por pregunta. Pensá rápido y tocá la respuesta correcta antes de que se acabe el tiempo!",q:[

]},
{id:"iatenc",name:"Atención y concentración",section:"Juegos de inteligencia",type:"mcq",color:"#4ade80",icon:"◎",intro:"Aquí tenés que mirar con atención y encontrar cuál es el elemento distinto o cuál no pertenece al grupo. Concentrate!",q:[

 ["¿Cuál es diferente? 2 4 6 7",["2","4","6","7"],3,"Cuál es diferente? Dos, cuatro, seis, siete. El siete es impar!"],

 ["¿Cuál es diferente? ★ ★ ☆ ★",["★","☆","iguales","ninguno"],1,"Cuál es diferente? Hay una estrella vacía entre estrellas llenas."]
]},
{id:"ipuzzle",name:"Rompecabezas",section:"Juegos de inteligencia",type:"puzzle",color:"#a78bfa",icon:"▦",intro:"Un rompecabezas o puzzle es un juego donde las piezas están desordenadas y tenés que ordenarlas. Tocá un número al lado del espacio vacío para moverlo. Ordená del 1 al 8!"},
{id:"isudoku",name:"Sudoku infantil",section:"Juegos de inteligencia",type:"sudoku",color:"#22d3ee",icon:"#",intro:"El sudoku es un juego de números: en cada fila y cada columna tienen que estar los números 1, 2, 3 y 4 sin repetirse. Tocá una casilla vacía para cambiar el número. Completá todo bien!"},
{id:"ilaber",name:"Laberintos",section:"Juegos de inteligencia",type:"maze",color:"#4ade80",icon:"⌘",intro:"Un laberinto es un camino con paredes donde tenés que encontrar la salida. Usá las flechas para mover a Buggy hasta la estrella. ¡Cuidado con las paredes!"},
{id:"iasoc",name:"Asociar imágenes",section:"Juegos de inteligencia",type:"match",color:"#facc15",icon:"⇄",intro:"Asociar significa unir dos cosas que van juntas. Tocá primero una figura de la izquierda y luego su nombre de la derecha. Si coinciden, quedan unidas!"},
{id:"idiff",name:"Encontrar diferencias",section:"Juegos de inteligencia",type:"diff",color:"#f472b6",icon:"✕",intro:"Encontrar diferencias significa mirar dos grupos y descubrir qué cambió. Arriba está el modelo, abajo una casilla es distinta. Tocá la casilla distinta de abajo!"},

/* ---- AVENTURAS / PREMIUM: 15 minijuegos nuevos ---- */
{id:"av_puzzle",name:"Rompecabezas de imágenes",section:"Aventuras",type:"jigsaw",color:"#a78bfa",icon:"▦",premium:false,intro:"En el rompecabezas las piezas están mezcladas. Tocá una pieza y luego otra para intercambiarlas. ¡Ordená la imagen colorida! Elegí la dificultad: 3x3, 4x4 o 5x5."},
{id:"av_mem",name:"Memoria de animales",section:"Aventuras",type:"memory",color:"#fb923c",icon:"♞",sym:"animals",premium:false,intro:"Encontrá las parejas de animales iguales. Tocá dos tarjetas: si son iguales quedan boca arriba. ¡Encontrá todos los pares!"},
{id:"av_laber",name:"Laberinto de la mascota",section:"Aventuras",type:"maze",color:"#4ade80",icon:"⌘",premium:false,intro:"Ayudá a la mascota a salir del laberinto. Usá las flechas para moverla hasta la estrella. ¡Cuidado con las paredes!"},
{id:"av_globos",name:"Reventar globos",section:"Aventuras",type:"balloons",color:"#f472b6",icon:"◉",premium:false,intro:"Volan muchos globos de colores. Tenés que reventar solo los globos ROJOS. Si reventás uno de otro color perdés una vida. ¡Reventá 5 globos rojos!"},
{id:"av_blanco",name:"Tiro al blanco",section:"Aventuras",type:"target",color:"#f87171",icon:"◎",premium:false,intro:"Aparecen blancos en la pantalla y desaparecen rápido. Apuntá con el dedo y tocá el blanco antes de que se escape. ¡Acertá 6!"},
{id:"av_runner",name:"Carrera de obstáculos",section:"Aventuras",type:"runner",color:"#22d3ee",icon:"➤",premium:false,intro:"Tu personaje corre solo. Tocá el botón SALTAR para saltar los obstáculos. Si chocás perdés una vida. ¡Llegá a la meta después de 8 obstáculos!"},
{id:"av_detec",name:"Detective: buscar pistas",section:"Aventuras",type:"detective",color:"#a78bfa",icon:"✦",premium:false,intro:"Sos detective en una escena misteriosa. Encontrá los objetos escondidos que pide la lista. Tocá cada objeto para encontrarlo. ¡Encontrálos todos!"},
{id:"av_pesca",name:"Pesca divertida",section:"Aventuras",type:"fishing",color:"#38bdf8",icon:"≈",premium:false,intro:"Los peces nadan en el río. Pescá solo los peces DORADos. Cuidado con las botas viejas, si las agarrás perdés una vida. ¡Pescá 5 peces dorados!"},
{id:"av_bloques",name:"Construcción con bloques",section:"Aventuras",type:"blocks",color:"#fb923c",icon:"▥",premium:false,intro:"Tenés que construir una torre igual al modelo. Tocá los bloques de colores en el orden correcto para armarla. ¡Construí 3 torres!"},
{id:"av_tren",name:"Armar la vía del tren",section:"Aventuras",type:"train",color:"#4ade80",icon:"🚂".replace("🚂","≡"),premium:false,intro:"Las vías del tren están desordenadas. Colocá las piezas en orden del 1 al 4 para que el tren llegue a destino. ¡Tocá una pieza y luego su lugar!"},
{id:"av_colfor",name:"Colores y formas",section:"Aventuras",type:"colorshapes",color:"#facc15",icon:"◐",premium:false,intro:"Cada figura tiene un color. Tocá una figura y luego su lugar correcto según el color. ¡Uní las 4 figuras!"},
{id:"av_sec",name:"Completar la secuencia",section:"Aventuras",type:"mcq",color:"#22d3ee",icon:"123",premium:false,intro:"Mirá la serie de números o figuras y descubrí qué elemento sigue. Pensá la regla y elegí la respuesta correcta.",q:[
 ["2, 4, 6, 8, ¿qué sigue?",["9","10","12","7"],1,"Serie sumando de a dos: 2,4,6,8,10."],
 ["1, 3, 5, 7, ¿qué sigue?",["8","9","10","11"],1,"Números impares: 1,3,5,7,9."],
 ["5, 10, 15, 20, ¿qué sigue?",["25","22","30","21"],0,"Sumando de a cinco: 5,10,15,20,25."],
 ["A, B, C, D, ¿qué letra sigue?",["F","E","G","H"],1,"Abecedario: A,B,C,D,E."],

 ["● ▲ ● ▲ ● ¿qué sigue?",["●","▲","■","★"],1,"Se repite círculo, triángulo."]
]},
{id:"av_diff",name:"Encuentra las diferencias",section:"Aventuras",type:"diff2",color:"#f472b6",icon:"✕",premium:false,intro:"Hay dos escenas casi iguales, pero en una cambió una cosa. Mirá con atención y tocá la casilla distinta de la escena de la derecha. ¡Encontrá 4 diferencias!"},
{id:"av_plat",name:"Salto de plataformas",section:"Aventuras",type:"platformer",color:"#4ade80",icon:"▲",premium:false,intro:"Tu personaje salta de plataforma en plataforma. Tocá SALTAR justo cuando la barra esté en la zona verde. ¡Llegá a la plataforma más alta!"},
{id:"av_tesoro",name:"Búsqueda del tesoro",section:"Aventuras",type:"treasure",color:"#facc15",icon:"◆",premium:false,intro:"Recorré el mapa de las islas. En cada isla hay una pregunta matemática: respondé bien para avanzar. ¡Llegá hasta el tesoro final!"},
{id:"av_rana",name:"Rana saltarina",section:"Aventuras",type:"frog",color:"#4ade80",icon:"♧",premium:false,intro:"Ayudá a la ranita a cruzar hasta la meta de arriba. Usá las flechas para saltar. ¡Cuidado con los autos que pasan! Llegá arriba sin ser atropellada."}

function loadSave(){try{var raw=localStorage.getItem("buggyV3");if(raw){var o=JSON.parse(raw);if(o&&o.stars){while(o.stars.length<CAT.length)o.stars.push(0);return o;}}}catch(e){}return {stars:CAT.map(function(){return 0;}),score:0};}
function checkDaily(){petInit();var today=new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);if(save.lastDay===today)return;var y=new Date(Date.now()-86400000).toISOString().slice(0,10);save.streak=(save.lastDay===y)?(save.streak||0)+1:1;save.lastDay=today;var bonus=10+save.streak*3;save.pet.coins+=bonus;persist();setTimeout(function(){var m=document.createElement("div");m.className="modal-bg";m.innerHTML='<div class="glass rounded-2xl p-5 text-center" style="max-width:320px;"><div style="font-size:40px;margin-bottom:6px;">★</div><h3 style="margin:0 0 6px;color:var(--gold);">¡Recompensa diaria!</h3><p style="margin:0 0 4px;font-size:14px;">Día seguido: <strong>'+save.streak+'</strong></p><p style="margin:0 0 12px;font-size:14px;">Ganaste <strong style="color:var(--gold);">● '+bonus+' monedas</strong> para tu mascota.</p><button class="btn rounded-xl px-5 py-2" style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--gold),#f59e0b);color:#7c2d12;font-weight:700;" onclick="this.parentElement.parentElement.remove();">¡Genial!</button></div>';document.body.appendChild(m);sndFanfare();},800);}
function persist(){try{localStorage.setItem("buggyV3",JSON.stringify(save));}catch(e){}}
function totalStars(){return save.stars.reduce(function(a,b){return a+b;},0);}

/* ==================== AUDIO ==================== */
var actx=null;
function ensureAudio(){if(!actx){try{actx=new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();}catch(e){}}if(actx&&actx.state==="suspended")actx.resume();}
function tone(f,d,del,type,vol){if(!actx)return;var t=actx.currentTime+(del||0);var o=actx.createOscillator(),g=actx.createGain();o.type=type||"sine";o.frequency.value=f;g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001,t);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(vol||.25,t+.02);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001,t+d);o.connect(g);g.connect(actx.destination);o.start(t);o.stop(t+d+.05);}
function sndClick(){ensureAudio();tone(660,.12,0,"triangle",.18);}
function sndCorrect(){ensureAudio();[523,659,784,1047].forEach(function(f,i){tone(f,.15,i*.11,"triangle",.22);});}
function sndWrong(){ensureAudio();tone(220,.25,0,"sawtooth",.15);tone(180,.3,.12,"sawtooth",.12);}
function sndFanfare(){ensureAudio();[523,659,784,1047,784,1047,1319].forEach(function(f,i){tone(f,.18,i*.13,"triangle",.22);});}
function sndTick(){ensureAudio();tone(880,.06,0,"square",.08);}

/* ==================== VOZ BILINGUE ==================== */
function pickVoices(){if(!window.speechSynthesis)return;var vs=speechSynthesis.getVoices();for(var i=0;i<vs.length;i++){var v=vs[i];if(!enVoice&&/en[-_](US|GB)/i.test(v.lang)&&/female|samantha|google|zira|aria|jenny|susan/i.test(v.name))enVoice=v;if(!esVoice&&/^es/i.test(v.lang)&&/female|google|elena|paulina|monica|carla|lucia|sabina/i.test(v.name))esVoice=v;}if(!enVoice)for(var j=0;j<vs.length;j++){if(/^en/i.test(vs[j].lang)){enVoice=vs[j];break;}}if(!esVoice)for(var k=0;k<vs.length;k++){if(/^es/i.test(vs[k].lang)){esVoice=vs[k];break;}}window.esVoices=[];for(var z=0;z<vs.length;z++){if(/^es/i.test(vs[z].lang))window.esVoices.push(vs[z]);}}
if(window.speechSynthesis){pickVoices();speechSynthesis.onvoiceschanged=pickVoices;}
var mouthClosed=$("mouthClosed"),mouthOpen=$("mouthOpen"),astroWrap=$("astroWrap"),rightArm=$("rightArm");
function startMouthTalk(){if(mouthTimer)clearInterval(mouthTimer);var ba=document.getElementById("buggy-avatar");if(ba)ba.classList.add("is-talking");if(mouthClosed&&mouthOpen){mouthClosed.style.display="none";mouthOpen.style.display="";mouthTimer=setInterval(function(){mouthOpen.style.transform="scaleY("+(0.35+Math.random()*0.75)+")";},110);}}
function stopMouthTalk(){var ba=document.getElementById("buggy-avatar");if(ba)ba.classList.remove("is-talking");if(mouthTimer){clearInterval(mouthTimer);mouthTimer=null;}if(mouthOpen&&mouthClosed){mouthOpen.style.transform="scaleY(0)";mouthOpen.style.display="none";mouthClosed.style.display="";}}
function say(text,lang,onend,rate){speechQ.push({text:text,lang:lang,onend:onend,rate:rate});pump();}
function pump(){
  if(speakingNow||!speechQ.length)return;
  if(!window.speechSynthesis){var it=speechQ.shift();if(it.onend)it.onend();pump();return;}
  speakingNow=true;var item=speechQ.shift();
  var u=new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(item.text);u.lang=item.lang;u.rate=item.rate||1;if(u.lang.indexOf('es')===0)u.lang='es-419';
  if(item.lang.indexOf("en")===0){if(enVoice)u.voice=enVoice;u.rate=0.65;}else{var _v=(window.esVoices&&window.esVoices.length)?window.esVoices[voiceIdx%window.esVoices.length]:esVoice;if(_v)u.voice=_v;u.rate=0.8;}
  u.pitch=1.1;u.volume=1;
  u.onstart=function(){startMouthTalk();(rightArm&&(rightArm.style.transform="rotate(-35deg)"));};
  u.onend=function(){speakingNow=false;stopMouthTalk();(rightArm&&(rightArm.style.transform="rotate(0deg)"));if(item.onend)item.onend();pump();};
  u.onerror=u.onend;speechSynthesis.speak(u);
}
function stopSpeak(){speechQ=[];if(window.speechSynthesis)speechSynthesis.cancel();speakingNow=false;stopMouthTalk();}
function teachCard(){
  if(!introPlaying) stopSpeak();var c=CAT[curCat].cards[idx];
  say("Mira. En castellano: "+c.es,"es-AR");
  say("Ahora escuchá cómo se pronuncia en inglés, despacio:","es-AR");
  say(c.en,"en-US",null,0.55);
  say("Y ahora normal:","es-AR");
  say(c.en,"en-US");
  say("Ahora repetí vos en inglés. Tocá el micrófono.","es-AR");
  sndClick();
}
function sayEnglishOnly(){stopSpeak();say(CAT[curCat].cards[idx].en,"en-US");sndClick();}

/* ==================== MICROFONO ==================== */
var SR=window.SpeechRecognition||window.webkitSpeechRecognition;
if(SR){recogSupported=true;recognition=new SR();recognition.lang="en-US";recognition.interimResults=false;recognition.maxAlternatives=3;
recognition.onresult=function(e){var target=CAT[curCat].cards[idx].en.toLowerCase();var got=false,tr="";for(var i=0;i<e.results[0].length;i++){var t=e.results[0][i].transcript.trim().toLowerCase();tr=tr||t;if(t===target||t.indexOf(target)>=0||(target.indexOf(t)>=0&&t.length>=2)){got=true;break;}}handleRepeatResult(got,tr);};
recognition.onerror=function(){stopListeningUI();setFeedback("No te oí bien. Intentá de nuevo.","var(--accent2)");};
recognition.onend=function(){stopListeningUI();};
}else{$("manualRow").style.display="block";$("micLabel").textContent="Practicar";}
function startListening(){if(!recogSupported){say("Repetí la palabra en inglés en voz alta.","es-AR");sndClick();return;}if(recognizing){try{recognition.stop();}catch(e){}return;}ensureAudio();try{recognition.start();recognizing=true;$("micBtn").classList.add("listening");$("micLabel").innerHTML='<span class="mic-wave"></span><span class="mic-wave"></span><span class="mic-wave"></span><span class="mic-wave"></span>';setFeedback("Te escucho... decí la palabra en inglés","var(--accent)");}catch(err){stopListeningUI();}}
function stopListeningUI(){recognizing=false;$("micBtn").classList.remove("listening");$("micLabel").textContent=recogSupported?"Repetir":"Practicar";}
function setFeedback(m,c){var fb=$("feedback");if(fb){fb.textContent=m;fb.style.color=c||"";}}
function handleRepeatResult(correct,tr){stopListeningUI();attempts++;if(correct){onCorrect("flash");setFeedback("¡Excelente! "+CAT[curCat].cards[idx].en,"var(--green)");say("¡Muy bien! Lo pronunciaste perfecto.","es-AR");}else{onWrong();setFeedback("Casi! Dijiste \""+(tr||"?")+"\". Escuchá de nuevo.","#f87171");say("Casi. Escuchá de nuevo y repetí despacio.","es-AR");}}

/* ==================== CORRECT / WRONG ==================== */
function onCorrect(kind){
  if(!correctSet[idx]){correctSet[idx]=true;earned++;if(attempts<=1)firstTry++;streak++;score+=10+(streak>=3?5:0);}else score+=2;
  save.score=score;persist();addPetCoins(10);updateHUD();sndCorrect();celebrate();
  try{ensureDaily();save.daily.correct++;persist();checkAchievements();}catch(e){}
  var cat=CAT[curCat];
  var total=cat.type==="flash"?cat.cards.length:(cat.type==="memory"?(gameLevel===2?8:6):6);
  if(kind!=="memory"&&earned>=total)setTimeout(showComplete,1500);
}
function onWrong(){streak=0;updateHUD();sndWrong();var wc=$("wordCard");if(wc){wc.classList.add("shake");setTimeout(function(){wc.classList.remove("shake");},500);}}

/* ==================== HUD ==================== */
function updateHUD(){
  $("scoreNum").textContent=score;$("streakNum").textContent=streak;
  var cat=CAT[curCat];var total=cat.type==="flash"?cat.cards.length:(cat.type==="memory"?(gameLevel===2?8:6):6);
  $("progressText").textContent=earned+" / "+total;
  $("progressFill").style.width=(earned/total*100)+"%";
  $("progressLabel").textContent=(cat.type==="math"||cat.type==="mcq"||cat.type==="type"||cat.type==="spell"||cat.type==="sentence"||cat.type==="story"||ARCADE_TYPES.indexOf(cat.type)>=0)?"Aciertos":(cat.type==="memory"?"Pares":"Progreso");
}

var canvas=$("confettiCanvas"),ctx=canvas.getContext("2d"),particles=[],confettiRunning=false;
function celebrate(){astroWrap.classList.remove("celebrate","celebrate-flip");void astroWrap.offsetWidth;if(Math.random()<0.5){astroWrap.classList.add("celebrate");}else{astroWrap.classList.add("celebrate-flip");}if(rightArm){rightArm.style.transform="rotate(-70deg)";setTimeout(function(){(rightArm&&(rightArm.style.transform="rotate(0deg)"));},2100);}burstConfetti(80);}
function resizeCanvas(){var r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();if(canvas.width!==r.width||canvas.height!==r.height){canvas.width=r.width;canvas.height=r.height;}}
function burstConfetti(n){resizeCanvas();var cols=["#22d3ee","#fb923c","#facc15","#4ade80","#f472b6","#a78bfa"];for(var i=0;i<n;i++)particles.push({x:canvas.width/2+(Math.random()-.5)*120,y:canvas.height*.35,vx:(Math.random()-.5)*9,vy:-Math.random()*9-3,size:Math.random()*7+4,color:cols[Math.floor(Math.random()*cols.length)],rot:Math.random()*6.28,vr:(Math.random()-.5)*.3,life:1});if(!confettiRunning)runConfetti();}
function runConfetti(){confettiRunning=true;resizeCanvas();ctx.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);var alive=[];for(var i=0;i<particles.length;i++){var p=particles[i];p.vy+=.25;p.x+=p.vx;p.y+=p.vy;p.rot+=p.vr;p.life-=.008;if(p.y<canvas.height+20&&p.life>0){alive.push(p);ctx.save();ctx.translate(p.x,p.y);ctx.rotate(p.rot);ctx.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,p.life);ctx.fillStyle=p.color;ctx.fillRect(-p.size/2,-p.size/2,p.size,p.size*.6);ctx.restore();}}particles=alive;if(particles.length>0)requestAnimationFrame(runConfetti);else{ctx.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);confettiRunning=false;}}
