function ensureDaily(){
  var t=new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);
  if(!save.daily||save.daily.date!==t){save.daily={date:t,correct:0,care:0,planet:0,claimed:{}};persist();}
}
function updateMissions(){
  try{
  ensureDaily();var ml=$("missionList");if(!ml)return;ml.innerHTML="";
  MISSIONS.forEach(function(m){
    var prog=Math.min(m.goal,m.get());var done=prog>=m.goal;var claimed=save.daily.claimed[m.id];
    var row=document.createElement("div");
    row.style.cssText="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border-radius:12px;padding:7px 10px;border:1px solid var(--border);";
    var info=document.createElement("div");info.style.flex="1";
    info.innerHTML='<div style="font-size:13px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:3px;">'+m.name+'</div><div class="stat-bar" style="height:8px;"><div class="stat-fill" style="width:'+(prog/m.goal*100)+'%;background:var(--gold);"></div></div><div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:2px;font-weight:600;">'+prog+'/'+m.goal+'</div>';
    row.appendChild(info);
    var btn=document.createElement("button");
    if(claimed){btn.textContent="✓ Reclamado";btn.disabled=true;btn.style.cssText="background:rgba(74,222,128,.25);color:#4ade80;border-radius:999px;padding:6px 12px;font-weight:800;font-size:12px;border:none;";}
    else if(done){btn.textContent="+"+m.reward+" monedas";btn.style.cssText="background:linear-gradient(135deg,#facc15,#f59e0b);color:#7c2d12;border-radius:999px;padding:6px 12px;font-weight:900;font-size:12px;border:none;cursor:pointer;animation:alertPulse 1.4s infinite;";btn.addEventListener("click",function(){claimMission(m.id);});}
    else{btn.textContent="● "+m.reward;btn.disabled=true;btn.style.cssText="background:rgba(139,147,194,.2);color:var(--muted);border-radius:999px;padding:6px 12px;font-weight:700;font-size:12px;border:none;";}
    row.appendChild(btn);ml.appendChild(row);
  });
  var sd=$("streakDays");if(sd)sd.textContent=save.streak||0;
  }catch(e){}
}
function claimMission(id){
  ensureDaily();var m=null;for(var i=0;i<MISSIONS.length;i++)if(MISSIONS[i].id===id)m=MISSIONS[i];if(!m||save.daily.claimed[id])return;
  save.daily.claimed[id]=true;save.pet.coins+=m.reward;persist();try{sndFanfare();}catch(e){}
  try{showToast("Mision completada! +"+m.reward+" monedas");}catch(e){}
  updateMissions();try{updateHomePetWidget();}catch(e){}
}
function checkAchievements(){
  try{
  if(!save.ach)save.ach={};var unlocked=0;
  ACHS.forEach(function(a){
    if(!save.ach[a.id]&&a.need()){save.ach[a.id]=true;save.pet.coins+=a.reward;unlocked++;
      try{showToast("Logro desbloqueado: "+a.name+"! +"+a.reward+" monedas");}catch(e){}
    }
  });
  if(unlocked>0){persist();try{sndFanfare();}catch(e){}}
  }catch(e){}
}
function showAchievements(){
  checkAchievements();if(!save.ach)save.ach={};
  var g=$("achGrid");g.innerHTML="";
  ACHS.forEach(function(a){
    var got=!!save.ach[a.id];
    var d=document.createElement("div");
    d.style.cssText="border-radius:14px;padding:10px;text-align:center;border:2px solid "+(got?"var(--gold)":"var(--border)")+";background:"+(got?"linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(250,204,21,.18),rgba(244,114,182,.12))":"rgba(255,255,255,.03)")+";opacity:"+(got?1:.55)+";";
    d.innerHTML='<div style="font-size:26px;margin-bottom:2px;">'+(got?a.icon:"?")+'</div><div style="font-size:12px;font-weight:800;line-height:1.2;">'+a.name+'</div><div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--gold);font-weight:700;margin-top:2px;">● '+a.reward+'</div>';
    g.appendChild(d);
  });
  $("achModal").style.display="flex";try{sndClick();}catch(e){}
}
function refreshPetBars(){
  petInit();var p=save.pet;
  $("statHappy").style.width=Math.min(100,p.happy)+"%";$("statHappyN").textContent=Math.round(p.happy);
  $("statFood").style.width=Math.min(100,p.food)+"%";$("statFoodN").textContent=Math.round(p.food);
  $("statEnergy").style.width=Math.min(100,p.energy)+"%";$("statEnergyN").textContent=Math.round(p.energy);
  $("statHygiene").style.width=Math.min(100,p.hygiene)+"%";$("statHygieneN").textContent=Math.round(p.hygiene);
  $("petCoins").textContent=p.coins;
  updatePetAlert();renderPetFlies();
}
function updateHomePetWidget(){
  try{
    petInit();var p=save.pet;if(!p||!p.chosen)return;
    var n=$("hwPetName");if(!n)return;
    n.textContent=p.name;
    $("hwFood").style.width=Math.min(100,p.food)+"%";
    $("hwHygiene").style.width=Math.min(100,p.hygiene)+"%";
    var msg=$("hwMsg");
    if(p.food<25)msg.textContent="Tiene hambre! Juga y gana monedas para alimentarla.";
    else if(p.hygiene<25)msg.textContent="Esta sucia! Necesita un bano.";
    else msg.textContent="Esta bien! Explora el Sistema Solar y gana premios.";
  }catch(e){}
}
function openPlanets(){
  openPetScreen();
  setTimeout(function(){try{petAction("planets");}catch(e){}},450);
}
function startPetLoop(){
  if(_petLoopStarted)return;_petLoopStarted=true;
  setInterval(function(){
    petInit();var p=save.pet;if(!p||!p.chosen)return;
    p.food=Math.max(0,p.food-1.6);
    p.hygiene=Math.max(0,p.hygiene-0.7);
    p.energy=Math.max(0,p.energy-0.45);
    if(p.food<=0)p.happy=Math.max(0,p.happy-1.8);else p.happy=Math.max(0,p.happy-0.35);
    p.lastTick=Date.now();persist();
    try{updateHomePetWidget();}catch(e){}
    var ps=$("petScreen");if(ps&&!ps.classList.contains("hidden-screen")){refreshPetBars();}
  },5000);
}
function applyOfflineDecay(){
  petInit();var p=save.pet;if(!p.lastTick)return;
  var mins=(Date.now()-p.lastTick)/60000;if(mins<0.5)return;mins=Math.min(mins,90);
  p.food=Math.max(0,p.food-mins*3);
  p.hygiene=Math.max(0,p.hygiene-mins*1.2);
  p.energy=Math.max(0,p.energy-mins*0.8);
  if(p.food<=0)p.happy=Math.max(0,p.happy-mins*3);
  p.lastTick=Date.now();persist();
}
function petSay(text){
  var b=$("petBubble");if(!b)return;
  b.textContent=text;b.classList.add("show");
  if(_petBubbleT)clearTimeout(_petBubbleT);
  _petBubbleT=setTimeout(function(){b.classList.remove("show");},4200);
  try{say(text,"es-AR");}catch(e){}
}
function petBabble(){
  petInit();var p=save.pet;var st=p.stage||0;
  if(st===0)return "Toc toc... pronto saldre de mi cascaron!";
  if(st===1){var w1=["Hola!","Te quiero!","Juguemos!","Tengo hambre!","Soy "+p.name+"!","Que feliz!"];return w1[Math.floor(Math.random()*w1.length)];}
  var w2=["Hola! Como estas hoy?","Te quiero mucho!","Juguemos juntos, me divierto!","Gracias por cuidarme todos los dias!","Eres mi mejor amigo!","Me siento muy feliz contigo!","Hoy vamos a aprender algo nuevo!","Vamos a explorar el Sistema Solar!","Me encanta cuando estas conmigo!"];
  return w2[Math.floor(Math.random()*w2.length)];
}
function petMoodPhrase(){
  petInit();var p=save.pet;
  if(p.food<15)return "Tengo muchisima hambre! Por favor, dame de comer...";
  if(p.hygiene<20)return "Estoy todo sucio... me banias, porfa?";
  if(p.energy<15)return "Tengo mucho sueno... necesito dormir un rato.";
  if(p.happy<25)return "Estoy un poco triste... jugamos o me acaricias?";
  if(p.food<35)return "Ya tengo hambrecita. Comprame comida con monedas!";
  return petBabble();
}
function updatePetAlert(){
  var al=$("petAlert");if(!al)return;petInit();var p=save.pet;
  var hasFood=false;for(var k in p.foods){if(p.foods[k]>0){hasFood=true;break;}}
  var cheapest=999;FOODS.forEach(function(f){if(f.price<cheapest)cheapest=f.price;});
  if(p.food<25&&!hasFood&&p.coins<cheapest){
    al.innerHTML=p.name+" tiene HAMBRE y no tenes comida ni monedas!<br><button onclick=\"goPlayForFood()\">JUGAR Y GANAR MONEDAS</button>";
    al.className="pet-alert";
  }else if(p.food<25&&!hasFood){
    al.innerHTML=p.name+" tiene hambre! Anda a la Tienda a comprarle comida.";
    al.className="pet-alert";
  }else{
    al.innerHTML="";al.className="";
  }
}
function goPlayForFood(){
  try{sndClick();}catch(e){}try{stopSpeak();}catch(e){}
  var ps=$("petScreen");if(ps)ps.classList.add("hidden-screen");
  $("homeScreen").classList.remove("hidden-screen");try{renderHome();}catch(e){}
  try{showToast("Juga y gana monedas para alimentar a tu mascota!");}catch(e){}
}
function renderPetFlies(){
  var fl=$("petFlies");if(!fl)return;fl.innerHTML="";
  petInit();if(save.pet.hygiene>=30)return;
  for(var i=0;i<3;i++){
    var f=document.createElement("span");f.className="dirty-fly";f.textContent="~";
    f.style.left=(8+Math.random()*70)+"%";f.style.top=(5+Math.random()*55)+"%";
    f.style.animationDelay=(i*.35)+"s";f.style.color="#94a3b8";f.style.fontWeight="900";
    fl.appendChild(f);
  }
}
function renderPlanets(){
  var c=$("petContent");
  var vc=0;for(var _vk in (save.pet.visited||{}))vc++;var html='<div style="font-size:14px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:8px;text-align:center;font-weight:700;">Toca un planeta para viajar con '+save.pet.name+'! (cuesta 10 de energia) · Descubiertos: '+vc+'/8</div><div class="planet-wrap" id="planetWrap"><div class="planet-sun"></div>';
  var radii=[54,76,98,120];
  for(var i=0;i<4;i++)html+='<div class="orbit-ring" style="width:'+(radii[i]*2)+'px;height:'+(radii[i]*2)+'px;"></div>';
  var pos=[[86,28],[90,68],[66,90],[28,88],[8,58],[14,24],[32,8],[70,14]];
  var idx=0;
  PLANETS.forEach(function(pl){
    if(pl.id==="sol")return;
    var sz=(pl.id==="jupiter"||pl.id==="saturno")?24:17;
    var pp=pos[idx%pos.length];idx++;
    html+='<div class="planet-dot" data-planet="'+pl.id+'" title="'+pl.name+'" style="left:'+pp[0]+'%;top:'+pp[1]+'%;width:'+sz+'px;height:'+sz+'px;background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%,#ffffff,'+pl.color+' 70%);color:'+pl.color+';"></div>';
  });
  html+='</div>';
  c.innerHTML=html;
  Array.prototype.forEach.call(c.querySelectorAll("[data-planet]"),function(d){
    d.addEventListener("click",function(){visitPlanet(d.dataset.planet);});
  });
}
function visitPlanet(pid){
  petInit();var p=save.pet;var pl=null;
  for(var i=0;i<PLANETS.length;i++){if(PLANETS[i].id===pid){pl=PLANETS[i];break;}}
  if(!pl)return;
  if(p.energy<10){petMsg("No hay energia para viajar! Hace que duerma primero.","#f87171");try{sndWrong();}catch(e){}return;}
  p.energy-=10;p.coins+=pl.reward;p.babble=(p.babble||0)+1;p.affection=Math.min(100,(p.affection||50)+2);p.visited=p.visited||{};p.visited[pid]=true;persist();try{ensureDaily();save.daily.planet=1;checkAchievements();}catch(e){}
  var av=$("petAvatar");if(av){av.classList.add("pet-travel");setTimeout(function(){av.classList.remove("pet-travel");},900);}
  try{sndFanfare();}catch(e){}
  renderPet();
  petMsg("Viaje a "+pl.name+"! Ganaste "+pl.reward+" monedas. "+pl.fact,"var(--purple)");
  petSay("Guau! "+pl.name+" es increible!");
}
var selectedPet=0,petSleeping=false,playCatches=0,bathStep=0;
function petInit(){
  if(!save.pet){save.pet={type:"perro",name:"Buggy Jr",coins:30,happy:60,food:60,energy:60,hygiene:60,foods:{manzana:2,banana:2},totalCorrect:0,stage:0,chosen:false,affection:50,lastTick:Date.now(),babble:0};persist();}
  if(!save.pet.foods)save.pet.foods={};
}
function shade(hex,amt){
  try{var n=parseInt(hex.slice(1),16);var r=(n>>16)&255,g=(n>>8)&255,b=n&255;
  r=Math.max(0,Math.min(255,Math.round(r+amt*255)));g=Math.max(0,Math.min(255,Math.round(g+amt*255)));b=Math.max(0,Math.min(255,Math.round(b+amt*255)));
  return "rgb("+r+","+g+","+b+")";}catch(e){return hex;}
}

  else if(p.ear==="cir")ear='<circle cx="74" cy="66" r="21" fill="'+cD+'"/><circle cx="166" cy="66" r="21" fill="'+cD+'"/><circle cx="74" cy="66" r="10" fill="'+cL+'"/><circle cx="166" cy="66" r="10" fill="'+cL+'"/>';

  if(st===0){return '<svg viewBox="0 0 240 260" width="195" height="210"><ellipse cx="120" cy="210" rx="46" ry="12" fill="#000" opacity=".25"/><ellipse cx="120" cy="140" rx="62" ry="78" fill="'+c+'"/><ellipse cx="96" cy="112" rx="16" ry="28" fill="#fff" opacity=".45" transform="rotate(-18 96 112)"/><ellipse cx="120" cy="205" rx="42" ry="14" fill="'+cD+'" opacity=".55"/><circle cx="104" cy="158" r="6.5" fill="#1e293b"/><circle cx="136" cy="158" r="6.5" fill="#1e293b"/><circle cx="106" cy="155" r="2" fill="#fff"/><circle cx="138" cy="155" r="2" fill="#fff"/><ellipse cx="120" cy="176" rx="7" ry="5" fill="#3b1d0e"/><path d="M110 186 Q120 194 130 186" stroke="#3b1d0e" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>';}
  var eyes=petSleeping?'<path d="M96 108 q8 8 16 0" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="3.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M144 108 q8 8 16 0" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="3.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>':'<circle cx="100" cy="108" r="9" fill="#1e293b"/><circle cx="148" cy="108" r="9" fill="#1e293b"/><circle cx="103" cy="104" r="3.2" fill="#fff"/><circle cx="151" cy="104" r="3.2" fill="#fff"/><circle cx="97" cy="112" r="1.6" fill="#fff" opacity=".7"/><circle cx="145" cy="112" r="1.6" fill="#fff" opacity=".7"/>';
  var hat=st>=3?'<rect x="90" y="42" width="60" height="11" rx="5" fill="#7c3aed"/><rect x="102" y="14" width="36" height="32" rx="8" fill="#7c3aed"/><circle cx="120" cy="12" r="7" fill="#facc15"/>':'';
  var tail='<path d="M174 198 Q208 180 202 148" stroke="'+cD+'" stroke-width="14" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle cx="202" cy="146" r="11" fill="'+cL+'"/>';
  return '<svg viewBox="0 0 240 260" width="195" height="210">'+
    '<ellipse cx="120" cy="246" rx="52" ry="10" fill="#000" opacity=".25"/>'+

    '<ellipse cx="120" cy="204" rx="56" ry="44" fill="'+c+'"/>'+
